31. Another material point of loss of future income is concerned, the petitioner herein, asserting that, he has sustained permanent disability,
consequent upon the injury sustained by him.

In order to prove the same, the petitioner has not placed the  24 SCCH-18 MVC 979/2020 evidence of the doctor or placed disability certificate except the production of the medical documents as per Ex.P7, Ex.P9 to Ex.P13 as discussed above.

It is the duty of the applicant to place relevant medical documents along with the evidence of doctor to prove his disability consequent upon the injuries sustained by him in the accident, which caused loss of future income to him.
In the absence of all these factors, court cannot consider the head of compensation towards loss of future income.
Accordingly, the petitioner herein has not placed satisfactory evidence to consider the compensation under this head.
Hence, the petitioner is not entitle for compensation under the head of loss of future income.
